No task needs AI.

## Task 1 · The fishing pond (3 marks)

A player fishes in a pond. Each cast gives an old boot (weight 50, 0 coins),
a small fish (weight 35, 4 coins), a big fish (weight 14, 15 coins) or a
golden fish (weight 1, 200 coins).

a) Compute the expected coins per cast. How many casts does a player need on
average for a fishing rod of 220 coins? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) The golden fish has p = 0.01. What is the chance to catch at least one in
100 casts? (Use 0.99¹⁰⁰ ≈ 0.37.) (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) Players complain about the golden fish. Propose a pity timer (after how
many casts?) and say in one sentence what it changes for the players.
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · The wizard's spell (2 marks)

A wizard's spell succeeds with probability 0.8.

a) What is the probability of 2 failures in a row at one given place? What
is P(at least one failure in 2 casts)? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) A critical spell comes with 10 %, and players complain about long runs
without one. Design a shuffle bag: what is in the bag, and what is the
longest possible run without a critical spell? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}
